newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin closes unchanged on short-covering.
newsitem.headline: KL tin closes unchanged on short-covering.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price closed unchanged at 14.29 ringgit ($5.77) a kg on short-covering by European and local buyers despite an overnight fall on the London Metal Exchange (LME), traders said.
"There was buying at lower level and this helped the market close steady, otherwise it would have followed the LME," said a trader.
Final turnover was 87 tonnes, against 58 on Tuesday, and was absorved by European and Malaysian interests. The local price price was at a premium of $90 against LME, from $65 previously.
